_readme: The script discovers tool names, loading tier, audience availability, feature gates and shell coupling from the product source. This file adds what source can't say in user terms:
a one-line summary, the display group, the default approval behaviour and the config keys a reader would reach for.

Approval defaults come from Netclaw.Configuration/ToolAudienceProfiles.cs (CreateProfilesForPosture), Netclaw.Actors/Tools/FilePathApprovalMatcher.cs and docs/runbooks/tool-approval-gates.md. Re-read them at each release.
A tool that appears in source but not here fails the run, so a new tool can't ship undocumented.

groups.title: Files
groups.intro: File tools respect the audience's `ReadFiles`, `WriteFiles` and `AttachFiles` roots. By default Public reaches only its own session directory, Team adds `GlobalReadRoots` for reads, and Personal reaches any path that isn't protected.

file_read.summary: Read a text file. Images load for models that accept them, and PDFs, media and archives return metadata.
file_read.approval: Runs without a prompt. Protected files such as `secrets.json` and credential folders such as `~/.ssh` are denied.

file_search.summary: Search authorized files by name or UTF-8 text, recursively, without a shell.

tool_output_read.summary: Read the rest of a truncated tool result by call ID. Large output is spilled to a session file and this tool pages through it.

file_write.summary: Create or replace a file, creating parent directories.
file_write.approval: Runs without a prompt. Writes under the config directory are always denied.

file_edit.summary: Replace literal text in a file, or write the whole file.
file_edit.approval: Runs without a prompt. Edits under the config directory are always denied.

attach_file.summary: Send an existing file to the user in the chat.

set_working_directory.summary: Declare the project directory for the session. It scopes path checks and shell approvals and loads the project's `AGENTS.md`.

shell_execute.summary: Run a shell command. Pass `_background: true` to run it as a background job.
shell_execute.approval: Prompts on Personal unless a saved grant or the reviewed-safe command list covers it. Never available to Team or Public.

check_background_job.summary: Check the status and output tail of a background job, or cancel it.

web_search.summary: Search the web and return titles, URLs and snippets.

web_fetch.summary: Download a URL to a local file and return a preview.

find_memories.summary: Search memory. Returns IDs, titles, scores and snippets.

get_memories.summary: Load the full text of memories by ID.

update_memory.summary: Edit or delete a memory by ID.

skill_load.summary: Load a skill's instructions and list its reference files.

skill_read_resource.summary: Read a resource file from a skill directory.

skill_manage.summary: Create, edit, patch or delete skills and their resource files.

search_tools.summary: Search deferred tools by keyword, or list MCP servers. Doesn't load anything.

load_tool.summary: Load a deferred tool by exact name so the model can call it.

set_reminder.summary: Create or update a reminder from a relative time, an `every 6h` interval or a cron expression.

list_reminders.summary: List reminders with schedules, status and next run.

cancel_reminder.summary: Cancel a reminder. A one-shot is deleted and its history stays readable for 12 days. A recurring reminder is disabled and kept.

get_reminder_history.summary: Show recent runs of a reminder with outcome, duration and session ID.

run_reminder.summary: Run a reminder's prompt in the current chat so you can answer approval prompts and save grants for the unattended run.

set_webhook.summary: Create or update an inbound webhook route.

list_webhooks.summary: List webhook routes and whether each one loads.

delete_webhook.summary: Delete a webhook route by name.

spawn_agent.summary: Hand a task to a subagent. It returns a run ID at once, the child works in the background, and the result arrives in a later turn as a notice that names its `result.md`.

check_agent_run.summary: Read the status of a child run you started, or ask it to cancel. Subagents can't call it.

send_channel_message.summary: Post to a channel or send a direct message on Slack, Discord or Mattermost, using IDs from the lookup tools.

lookup_channel_user.summary: Resolve a person to a stable user ID on an enabled channel.

lookup_channel_destination.summary: Resolve a channel name to a stable ID, or list every destination the bot can reach.

lookup_slack_user.summary: Find a Slack user by name, display name or email.

lookup_mattermost_user.summary: Find a Mattermost user by username or email.
